name: rail
title: Rail
description: The module rail down the app's start edge: about seven modules, each an icon over a short label with a compact count badge or a dot, and a bottom group. Server-rendered; an item's animated icon loads when the browser is idle.

meta.whenToUse: The app's modules in the shell (Shell's rail).
meta.whenNotToUse: A module's own places (NavTree in the column), search, help or the account (the global bar), or a phone (ShellBottomBar).
